meta.title: My UoPeople journey
meta.description: My University of the People journey, from the first application to two computer science degrees. The costs, transfer credits, and milestones I can document.
meta.coverageNote: Confirmed expenses: $581.89. Based on receipts, the university ledger and academic records. The one rupee payment is converted to dollars at the ECB reference rate on its payment date.

summary.scholarshipNote: {amount} assessment scholarship awarded; 10 course assessments confirmed covered. Application fee covered separately by a grant. Awarded support is excluded from personal spending.

spending.label: Application fee · covered by grant
spending.source: Admissions email: Great News! Your application fee is covered!, 24 Apr 2025 IST
spending.note: The email explicitly awards a grant covering the application fee. No personal cash payment counted.

spending.label: Assessment fees · scholarship
spending.source: Financial Aid award email, 14 May 2025; UoPeople transaction report, 27 Oct 2026
spending.note: $2,100 was awarded at $140 per course for 15 assessments. The ledger confirms 10 actual assessment entries covered. The award is not cash paid by me and is not a claim that all $2,100 was used.

spending.label: Coursera Plus · one month
spending.source: Coursera purchase receipt, 19 Sep 2025; cancellation confirmation, 24 Sep 2025
spending.note: Receipt total includes GST. Access continued until 18 Oct 2025 after renewal was cancelled. Cancellation was not a refund. This subscription overlaps the September Google/IBM credentials used for transfer. Converted to USD at ₹88.16 per $1, the ECB reference rate on the payment date (via Frankfurter).

spending.label: Coursera credit transfer · 21 × $17
spending.source: UoPeople transaction report (27 Oct 2026) + matching payment receipt email
spending.note: The PayPal authorization and university receipt describe the same payment and are counted once. Dates follow the university ledger.

spending.label: Sophia Learning · one month
spending.source: Sophia receipt and bank debit email, 31 Oct 2025
spending.note: $99 membership less a $20 discount. Access through 29 Nov 2025. Renewal cancelled on purchase day; no refund found. The INR bank debit is the same purchase, not an additional expense.

spending.label: Sophia credit transfer · 9 courses
spending.source: Final transcript, transaction report and official Sophia–UoPeople partnership
spending.note: 27 credits accepted on the final transcript. No separate Sophia transfer payment appears in the university ledger; the partnership covers up to 20 Sophia courses. Exact transfer-posting date is not documented.

timeline.title: Accepted, with the application fee covered
timeline.description: Welcome and financial-aid emails confirm the saved place and an application-fee grant. This is the first verified admission milestone, not a claim about the exact application-form submission time.
timeline.source: Admissions + Financial Aid emails, 24 Apr 2025 IST

timeline.title: $2,100 scholarship confirmed
timeline.description: Awarded $140 per course assessment for 15 courses. The later transaction report records 10 course assessments covered.

timeline.title: My first UoPeople term begins
timeline.description: Started with Online Education Strategies (UNIV 1001). This was Foundations study; formal degree-seeking status came later.

timeline.title: Tried Coursera Plus
timeline.description: Started a seven-day trial and cancelled on 19 July, before the scheduled charge. No trial payment is included.

timeline.title: One paid month of Coursera Plus
timeline.description: Paid ₹2,099 including GST (about $23.81). Google credentials were issued on 20 September and IBM credentials on 24 September in the supplied Credly transcript. Renewal was cancelled on 24 September; access lasted to 18 October.

timeline.title: Coursera transfer evaluation completed
timeline.description: The transfer office asked me to select approved courses and pay the processing fee. This was an evaluation decision, before the payment below.
timeline.source: Transfer-credit office and advisor emails, 10 Oct 2025

timeline.title: Paid for 21 Coursera transfer entries
timeline.description: Paid $357 in transfer processing fees: 21 accepted subject-credit entries × $17. The final transcript confirms 63 Coursera credits; the payment date is not a verified posting date.
timeline.source: Transfer evaluation + payment receipt + final transcript

timeline.title: A month of Sophia Learning
timeline.description: Paid $79 after a $20 discount. Completed 12 courses; 9 appear on my final UoPeople transcript, contributing 27 credits.
timeline.source: Sophia receipt + Sophia transcript + final UoPeople transcript

timeline.title: Formal degree-seeking enrollment
timeline.description: The final transcript records this enrollment date after Foundations study. This is why June and November both appear in my records.

timeline.title: Submitted Sophia courses for transfer review
timeline.description: Submitted the completed Sophia documents. The advisor confirmed they were under review on 18 November.

timeline.title: Sophia transfer evaluation updated
timeline.description: An earlier request was cancelled and resubmitted. The evaluation email still said pending payment; the final transcript is the evidence that nine courses were accepted.
timeline.source: Advisor and Transfer Credit emails, 26 Nov 2025; final transcript

timeline.title: Bachelor of Science awarded
timeline.description: Computer Science · GPA 3.77/4.00 · Magna Cum Laude. 120 credits: 90 transferred and 30 earned at UoPeople.

timeline.title: Ordered graduation documents and transcript
timeline.description: Paid $25 for the graduation document request and $15 for an official transcript.

timeline.title: Official digital graduation documents arrived
timeline.description: Student Services emailed the official graduation documents. This delivery date is separate from the 10 June degree conferral date.

timeline.title: Another official transcript
timeline.description: Paid $30 for an additional official transcript. This is a post-graduation expense included in the recorded total.

notes: This is my historical experience, not a quoted price or a promise of admission, scholarship or transfer approval for someone else. Check the linked official policies for your own application.

The cash total includes $357 in Coursera transfer processing, $70 in post-graduation documents, $79 for Sophia and $52.08 for three ProctorU purchases, plus ₹2,099 for Coursera Plus ($23.81 at the 19 Sep 2025 ECB rate). Scholarship awards and waived fees are excluded. Matching bank/payment-provider emails are not added again.

Scholarship amount awarded and amount used are different. The $2,100 award covered up to 15 assessments at $140 each. The report marks all 10 assessments taken as covered; it does not print the dollar value actually drawn.

Coursera rows are 21 accepted ACE subject-credit entries, not 21 separate certificate subscriptions. Program links are associated by matching ACE subject names to the Credly record; individual source-to-UoPeople destination pairs are not documented.

Sophia: 12 courses completed, 9 accepted, 27 transferred credits. Art History I, Introduction to Ethics and Workplace Communication were completed but do not appear as external credits on the final transcript. Calculus supplied 4 recommended credits but 3 were accepted.

Other Coursera purchases were reviewed and excluded: ten nutrition/fitness course receipts from 2024 and ten February 2025 receipts for Meta front-end courses and Prompt Engineering. These are not evidenced among the accepted degree transfer entries. The July 2025 Coursera trial was cancelled before billing. No refund or Parchment payment receipt was found in the targeted searches.

Dates use the university report for payments, diploma conferral dates for degrees, and India time for the admission milestone. Exam dates, purchase dates, document issue dates and degree award dates are distinct.
courseraDestinationNote: Saved portal evaluation lists these 21 destination courses, but does not show individual source-to-destination pairs. Do not invent one-to-one equivalences.

guide.title: Start with the official evaluation
guide.text: My final UoPeople transcript records the credits actually accepted: 63 from Coursera and 27 from Sophia. My Credly and Sophia transcripts establish the source study; a course completion certificate alone does not establish that UoPeople transferred it.
guide.source: Official bachelor transcript; Credly transcript; Sophia transcript

guide.title: Use the portal and keep the evidence
guide.text: The transfer guide supplied during my studies used Portal → Admissions → Transfer Credits → New Request, followed by transcript upload and Request Tracking. Keep the accepted evaluation, receipt and final degree audit together. This describes my 2025–26 process; check the current portal and policy before planning your own transfer.

guide.title: Separate learning costs from transfer fees
guide.text: I paid UoPeople $357 to transfer 21 Coursera subject-credit entries at $17 each. That payment is separate from Coursera subscriptions and any Sophia membership. Nine Sophia courses appear on the final transcript; no additional Sophia transfer payment appears in my UoPeople transaction report.
guide.source: Transaction report; transfer credit receipt; official bachelor transcript

guide.title: Check what counts before adding courses
guide.text: I completed 12 Sophia courses, but only 9 were transferred. Art History I, Introduction to Ethics and Workplace Communication are absent from my final transfer list. Sophia recommended 4 credits for Calculus I, while UoPeople accepted 3.
guide.source: Sophia transcript compared with official bachelor transcript

guide.title: Budget for the costs outside assessments
guide.text: All ten of my UoPeople course assessments were covered by scholarship. Proctoring, credit transfers and document fees still had separate charges. My award email confirms $2,100 of assessment support; a separate grant covered the application fee. The ledger confirms ten assessments used scholarship coverage.
guide.source: Financial Aid award and application-grant emails; transaction report; ProctorU receipts

guide.title: Finish the remaining university courses
guide.text: My bachelor’s total was 120 credits: 90 transferred and 30 earned through ten UoPeople courses. I began classes on June 19, 2025, earned the associate degree on April 1, 2026 and the bachelor’s on June 10, 2026. These were milestones on one study path; their credits and spending should not be added as two separate degrees.
guide.source: Enrollment agreement; official associate and bachelor diplomas/transcripts
